name: CHORUS
summary: CHORUS searched for tau-neutrino appearance in the CERN SPS wide-band beam using a hybrid emulsion detector and later produced extensive charm measurements from the same exposure.
physics_targets: Nuclear fragmentation and hadronic final states
detection_principle: A nuclear-emulsion target resolved short-lived tau and charm decays. Fibre trackers linked electronic tracks to emulsion, while a magnetic spectrometer, calorimeter and muon system reconstructed outgoing particles and selected candidate regions for microscopy.

results.summary: Published charm-production measurements from the emulsion sample, exploiting resolved decay vertices and automated scanning.
